verdict.rationale: Kimi documents agent capabilities that autonomously carry out multi-step work: the Kimi Code CLI can "autonomously complete development tasks", and kimi.com offers an Agent mode, Agent clusters and "Agent tasks". However, nothing shows these run asynchronously in the background or hand back a result for later review; they are described as conversational or terminal sessions, and the help entry on scheduled tasks covers recurring scheduling, not delegated autonomous work. missing for 10: documented background/asynchronous execution, a notification or return-for-review handoff, in-depth docs on Agent mode limits, independent hands-on corroboration of background delegation

support.subject: As a power-user, I can delegate a multi-step task that the assistant works on autonomously in the background and returns for my review
